_meta.probe: page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion }): 'no-preference' then 'reduce', same elements, same page
_meta.source: public pages, headless Chromium, read at rest
_meta.notes: Computed transitions and animations are read at rest; rules in :hover and other state selectors appear under `declared`. Outcome per element: removed (every transition and animation ends at or under 1 ms), reduced, kept, partial.
